item.description: Penn State will feature almost an entirely new group of starters on the defensive side of the ball in 2026 after losing a majority of last year’s team to the NFL draft, graduation or the transfer portal. item.title: Man Sentenced to Prison After Attempting to Hire Inmates to Kill Centre County Drug Case Informant
item.description: A man who Centre County prosecutors said twice tried to hire fellow jail inmates to murder an informant in a drug case has been sentenced to years in prison. Mark C. Hackett, 64, of Clearfield County, was sentenced by Centre County Judge Julia Rater last week to eight to 16 years in state prison, plus another five years for a parole violation, after pleading no contest to a charge of solicitation of murder and guilty to one felony count of delivering methamphetamine. item.title: Penn State Men’s Basketball Embarrassed by Wisconsin in Return to Rec Hall
item.description: Penn State returned to its old stomping grounds inside Rec Hall for the annual “Return to Rec” game against Wisconsin on Thursday night. The Nittany Lions had beaten ranked Badger squads in each of the last two meetings, but that wasn’t the case on a cold night in State College. item.title: State College Regional Airport Recorded Highest Post-COVID Passenger Activity in 2025
item.description: State College Regional Airport in 2025 had its highest level of passenger activity since the start of the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, airport officials said on Thursday. item.title: Beaver Stadium to Host Public Ice Skating
item.description: As Beaver Stadium gets ready to host Penn State hockey games for the first time, the public will have the opportunity to enjoy the ice. item.title: Major Winter Storm Expected to Bring Heavy Snowfall to Centre County. Here’s What to Know
item.description: A winter storm spanning a large swath of the country could bring Centre County's largest snow accumulation in more than five years after it arrives late Saturday night. The National Weather Service has issued a winter storm warning for the county from 10 p.m. Saturday to 1 p.m. Monday, with forecasts ranging from 8 to 18 inches of snow for the region. item.title: State College YMCA Celebrates Longtime Swimmer’s 100th Birthday
item.description: The State College YMCA celebrated its oldest active member Friday morning with a surprise birthday gathering honoring Maynard Kohler, a Ferguson Township resident who has spent decades swimming nearly every weekday morning at the facility on West Whitehall Road. Kohler, who turns 100 on Saturday, has been driving himself to the YMCA to swim every Monday through Friday for 22 years.
